name: std::codecvt_base
intro: The class std::codecvt_base provides the conversion status constants which are inherited and used by the std::codecvt facets.

sections.title: Member types
sections.text:
Member type

  Definition




  enum result { ok, partial, error, noconv };

  Unscoped enumeration type

Value

  Explanation




  ok

  conversion was completed with no error




  partial

  not all source characters were converted




  error

  encountered an invalid character




  noconv

  no conversion required, input and output types are the same

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: The value std::codecvt_base::partial is used to indicate that either the destination range is too short to receive the results of the conversion or the input is truncated in the middle of an otherwise valid multibyte character.

summary: The class std::codecvt_base provides the conversion status constants which are inherited and used by the std::codecvt facets.
